in_marathi.name: Ramanathan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Jewel of Rama
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ramanathan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Rama’ and ‘Anath’, meaning ‘Jewel of Rama’. This name is of great significance in Hindu mythology, as Rama is an avatar of the god Vishnu and a central figure in the ancient Indian epic ‘Ramayana’. Ramanathan represents strength, virtue, and devotion.

vedic_reference.note: Ramanathan is a Sanskrit name derived from Rama (God) and Anatha (God of Death). In Hindu mythology, Rama is an incarnation of Vishnu, who is known for his righteousness, strength, and devotion to his wife, Sita. The name Ramanathan can be seen as an expression of the belief that Rama, the god of righteousness, can protect one from the god of death, Anatha.
